    m.addConstr(3.92 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.97 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.21 * vars['Var_6'] + 9.85 * vars['Var_7'] + 7.07 * vars['Var_8'] <= 140.03, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(4.14 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.19 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.57 * vars['Var_5'] + 4.5 * vars['Var_7'] + 0.55 * vars['Var_8'] <= 149.35, name='C4')
